entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital and largest city of Avishkar (formerly Kaladesh), a center of aether technology and invention founded as neutral ground after the War of Eleven.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane, formerly called Kaladesh, whose capital is Ghirapur.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government seated in Ghirapur that promotes invention, creative freedom and progress.

entities.name: War of Eleven
entities.description: The war between eleven feuding principalities after which Ghirapur was founded as neutral ground.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: The massive central aether-collection tower of Ghirapur and symbol of Consulate power.

entities.name: Aetherflux Reservoir
entities.description: The largest aether storage facility in Ghirapur, struck at by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Akhara
entities.description: A round plaza arena used for public executions, site of Chandra's ignition and the Inventors' Fair finale.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whose ignition occurred at Akhara and who once burned down the Foundry of the Consuls.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn who owns the Prakhata Club and has a night market and statue in Ghirapur.

entities.name: Hiza
entities.description: An aetherborn crime lord who hides in the Janjeet Observatory Complex.

entities.name: Surash
entities.description: The reclusive elven keeper of the Cowl.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Became part of the Consulate after the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Kambal
entities.description: Lost his position after the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Lost his position after the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Developed Operation Golden Scales, a collection of bronze Dinosaurs, to defend Ghirapur.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A celebrated fair of invention hosted in Ghirapur.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The revolt hosted in Ghirapur in 4560 AR that changed the city's leadership.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion in which Ghirapur was a major target.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who sought to strike the Aetherflux Reservoir directly.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Stable portals that appeared in and around Ghirapur after the Invasion.

events.summary: Ghirapur is founded as neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities after the War of Eleven and grows to dominate its region.
events.quote: Ghirapur was founded in the aftermath of the War of Eleven as a neutral ground between eleven feuding principalities.

events.summary: Ghirapur hosts the Inventors' Fair and the Aether Revolt in 4560 AR, changing the city's leadership.
events.quote: causing a change in leadership for the city, with Pia Nalaar becoming part of the Consulate, while Kambal and Dovin Baan both lost their respective positions

events.summary: The Phyrexians target the Aetherflux Reservoir in the New Phyrexian Invasion and most citizens are evacuated beforehand.
events.quote: Most of the city's citizens were evacuated days before the invasion.

events.summary: Saheeli develops Operation Golden Scales, bronze Dinosaurs, to aid the city's defense.
events.quote: Saheeli developed 'Operation Golden Scales,' a collection of bronze Dinosaurs , to aid in the city's defense.

events.summary: After the Invasion, stable Omenpaths appear around Ghirapur, making it poised to be a center of multiversal trade.
events.quote: After the Invasion, a wealth of stable Omenpaths appeared in and around Ghirapur.
